claims.claim_text: Hoffman and colleagues (2012) reported a 38% reduction in fatigue scores at 12 weeks among 229 women with stage I-III breast cancer disease

A meta-analysis by Cramer et al. (2015) pooling 12 trials confirmed a moderate effect on depression symptoms (standardised mean difference -0.41, 95% CI -0.62 to -0.20) across diverse cancer populations
